palette.mood: A courtroom after hours: oxblood walls, walnut paneling, cream paper, brass fittings, one cobalt ink spent once per frame. Dry, careful, fair, never a dunk.
palette.divergence: Recorded palettes verbatim. 11-06 tangerine office, teal desks, cream legal pads, mint StampBot, magenta ink. 11-02 midnight indigo cab, sodium amber, electric teal stream, gunmetal, bone paper, magenta stamps. 11-01 overcast moss and slate. 10-31 sage and cream chart desk, cobalt sea, brass, vermilion. 10-29 aubergine dusk depot, gold. Honest overlap: cream paper, brass and a cobalt accent were in the 10-31 set. What is new is the ground. This film is oxblood wall panels and walnut under a low brass lamp with a cool grey-blue window rim (NOT teal), a copper-and-walnut recorder hero, a slate-lavender notetaker (NOT mint) and a burnt-orange audio cord (NOT sodium amber). Cobalt is spent only on the ink drop, the AI GENERATED tag and the TF-304 pen line, so the 10-31 cobalt sea never reassembles.

shape_language.grammar: ROUND reels, round faces and a round water glass against the RECTILINEAR doors, counter glass and paper. The recorder is a rounded walnut box with two big round reels for eyes; the court's rules are rectangular plates and doors.
shape_language.why: The thesis axis is a machine behind glass and a person in front of it. Round things hold the feeling, rectangles hold the rules, and the turn is a round recorder inside a rectangular door.

composition.safe_area: Hero action inside y420 to 1300. Captions at y1336 to 1472.
composition.signature_shot: Shot 9: window backlight from the upper right behind the glass, a tumbler at about 70 percent of frame height at ground-height lens, a clerk's gloved hand holds tweezers over the rim while a SEALED stamp hovers above, a cobalt drop falls and blooms through the whole glass and the tweezers can't pull any of it back. It is the only cobalt in frame.

craft_advance: Two techniques named with pass conditions. (1) The ink bloom: layered radial strands plus a growing translucent core inside the tumbler clip, timed to the confidential beat, passing if the bloom fills at least 60 percent of the glass by the SEALED beat and reads cobalt at thumbnail size. (2) The Reels face rig: reel-eye blink and spin with a mood brow and a mouth-flap on print, passing if the eyes are visibly open and spinning in S5 to S10 and S13. Fallbacks: if the Reels face rig misses its pass condition, fall back to reel-eye spin only with no brow or mouth flap. If the ink bloom is under 60 percent fill, use a layered radial bloom without strands.
